claims.qualifiers: She cites 24-strand DNA and 24 chromosomes for Swaruunianas.

claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: The account says hundreds would participate.

claims.assertion: Mari says this channel will publish Taygetan and Swaruunian conversations directly, without human interpreters' commentary.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She cites prior publishers' distortions and incomplete interpretations.
